QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] Go, Watson!
QuestInfo.0:
Rave saved a poor Glooger that was in danger. The Sketchy Hooligans ran off when they heard the goods belong to Plunk.

Talk to Rave about what to do now.
QuestInfo.1: You need to teach a lesson to the hoodlums in #bSketchy Back-Alley 1#k and retrieve the missing parts.
QuestInfo.2: You recovered an incomplete set of parts. You need to check if the rest are with Plunk. Return to the #bBlack Market#k.
